`official_records.json` contains the first three records, unchanged, from:

https://huggingface.co/datasets/mib-bench/ioi/resolve/e5f3468f3af4c0883be35cd3bced8c711c95d286/train.json

Dataset authors: MIB / mib-bench. Dataset card declares MIT. See the retained
official card in reports/upstream/dataset_card.md. No labels, prompts or
counterfactuals were created or modified. These are CPU validation fixtures.

`MIB_CODE_LICENSE.txt` is the exact Apache-2.0 license retrieved from the
official MIB **code** repository, https://github.com/aaronmueller/MIB/blob/main/LICENSE,
on 2026-10-23. It records the separate project-code license; it does not
replace the dataset card's MIT declaration.
